international.title: South Korea education minister resigns after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams
international.summary: Choi Kyo-jin says he ‘failed to prepare adequately’ for entrance exams, which this year had phones banned and checks for cameras hidden in clothing South Korea’s education minister has resigned after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to key university entrance exams last week. The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since last Sunday, when the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone to achieve a near-perfect score, just four days before the crucial university entrance exam, known as the suneung.
